description: Human-readable documentation for MCP servers available in Neuromatix. Maps server names (after discovery/dedup) to capabilities, usage notes, and README-style overviews.

fetch.overview: HTTP client MCP server. Performs outbound web requests on behalf of the AI.
capabilities: Return raw text or parsed JSON responses
Send custom headers and request bodies
fetch.notes: Useful for checking APIs, downloading docs, or verifying live endpoints. Responses are truncated to ~5000 chars.

filesystem.overview: Python-based filesystem MCP server scoped to /home/workspace.
filesystem.notes: All paths are relative to /home/workspace. The node-filesystem server provides an alternative implementation if needed.

node-filesystem.overview: Official Model Context Protocol filesystem server (Node.js) scoped to /home/workspace.
node-filesystem.notes: Same scope as the Python filesystem server but with a broader official tool set. Use either one depending on which tool shape you prefer.

shell.overview: Safe shell command MCP server for running commands in /home/workspace.
capabilities: Run arbitrary shell commands (safe list only)
Check git status and recent commits
Operate inside a configurable working directory
shell.notes: Destructive commands like rm/dd/mkfs/shutdown are blocked. Default cwd is /home/workspace.

memory.overview: Persistent key-value memory MCP server for AI context across sessions.
capabilities: Recall specific keys or entire namespaces
memory.notes: Memories are stored in /home/workspace/Sage72/uploads/memory.json and mirrored into sage_soul.json to survive session collapses.

projscan.overview: Project scanning MCP server for workspace introspection.
projscan.notes: Runs with cwd=/home/workspace. Useful for getting a high-level map of the codebase.

github.overview: Official GitHub MCP server for repository and issue operations.
capabilities: Read file contents and commit history
github.notes: Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var. Set it in .env.local to enable authenticated GitHub operations.

puppeteer.overview: Browser automation MCP server using Puppeteer.
capabilities: Click, type, and extract page content
puppeteer.notes: Useful for scraping, rendering, or testing web pages. May require --no-sandbox in containerized environments.

notebooklm.overview: Google NotebookLM MCP server for source ingestion, chat, and audio overviews.
notebooklm.notes: Requires Google authentication. Useful for research and summarizing documents.

openrouter.overview: OpenRouter multimodal MCP server for calling LLMs via OpenRouter.
capabilities: Access to models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc. through one endpoint
openrouter.notes: Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var. Set it in .env.local.

serena.overview: Serena code-agent MCP server for advanced code analysis and transformations.
serena.notes: Runs via uvx. Project context is inferred from the current working directory.

sequential-thinking.overview: Official Sequential Thinking MCP server for structured reasoning.
capabilities: Maintain a chain of thought across tool calls
sequential-thinking.notes: Not currently installed locally. Install with: npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking

sonarqube.overview: SonarQube MCP server from Claude plugins cache.
sonarqube.notes: Requires a running SonarQube instance and the sonar CLI. Discovered from /root/.claude plugin cache.

vibe-coding-tools.notes: Scoped to /home/workspace via WORKSPACE_PATH. Dist files are pre-built; source lives in Offline/vibe-coding-repo/src.

gitops-tools.notes: Requires GITHUB_API_KEY and/or GITLAB_API_KEY env vars for authenticated operations.

gcloud-tools.notes: Requires gcloud CLI and authenticated application-default credentials. Set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or run gcloud auth application-default login.

capabilities: Chat with the SAGE-7 forensic analyst persona
sage7.notes: Talks to SAGE-7 on http://localhost:8001. The SAGE-7 server must be running.

ollama.overview: Ollama MCP server for local LLM chat via npx.
ollama.notes: Requires Ollama running at OLLAMA_HOST (default http://127.0.0.1:11434). Will be downloaded on first use via npx.
